priorityList: Pre-combat: Buff Arcane Intellect, cast Mirror Image, and pre-cast Frostfire Bolt.
Activate Combustion while finishing a Fireball or Pyroblast cast, or immediately after casting Meteor.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during Combustion.
During Combustion, cast Meteor (ideally while Combustion has more than 2 seconds remaining).
Spend Hot Streak procs on Pyroblast instantly.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD during Combustion or Hyperthermia to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Cast Pyroblast when Pyroclasm is active, provided you do not have a Hot Streak proc.
In the filler phase, cast Meteor if it is available and you are not currently pooling for a Combustion window.
Use Fire Blast to bridge Heating Up into Hot Streak if your current hard-cast (Fireball or Pyroblast) will not naturally trigger a Hot Streak.
Spend Pyroclasm stacks on Pyroblast during the filler phase if you have 2 stacks or if Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds.
Cast Scorch when Heat Shimmer is active or if the target is below 30% health and Scald is talented.
Use Fireball (or Frostfire Bolt) as your primary filler to generate Heating Up and Hot Streak procs.
